Online evidence disappears or changes, and a conclusion is worth nothing if its origin cannot be proven.

Hash and chain every raw acquisition into an append-only store, keep the investigation replayable, and keep the reconstruction of the timeline apart from opinion.

It draws on these skills: [Web and media forensics](@/skills/media-forensics.md), [Chain of custody](@/skills/chain-of-custody.md), [Infrastructure OSINT](@/skills/infrastructure-osint.md), [Audit trail](@/skills/audit-trail.md), [Narrative and reputation analysis](@/skills/narrative-analysis.md) and [Source reliability](@/skills/source-reliability.md).

It is built with [Elixir](@/glossary/elixir.md), [PostgreSQL](@/glossary/postgresql.md) and [Lean](@/glossary/lean.md).

The technologies behind it, measured from the work that shows those skills: [HTML](@/glossary/html.md), [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md), [Python](@/glossary/python.md), [Alpine.js](@/glossary/alpine-js.md), [Claude API](@/glossary/claude-api.md), [Claude Code](@/glossary/claude-code.md), [Dockerfile](@/glossary/dockerfile.md) and [Flowbite Pro](@/glossary/flowbite-pro.md).

8 public repositories show its skills (8 by their own words).

It was delivered in client work under confidentiality agreements, in Real-estate developer and Financial and investment group, as Architect, Lead engineer, AI engineer, Data engineer, Investigator and Advisor; the use cases describe the principle and the intent, never a client, person, date or number.

How to read this page: the method and the use cases are written by me; the skills, technologies and public evidence are derived from measured data and link to their own pages, each a [repository](@/glossary/repository.md), a term or a skill.
